name: engineering-rules
description: The complete engineering law and working method as one progressive-disclosure skill, ten sub-commands and a standalone generate-pseudocode skill: hard caps and zero-tolerance bans, the file and folder organization law, performance/security/test-scenario/clean-code catalogs, an eight-phase workflow driven by a phase ledger that refuses to advance without its exit artifact, a run discipline (task start, phase boundaries, loop-backs, waiver limits, git safety, a law self-audit), a leftover sweep at every stage end with a dead-code cleanup commit and a reuse search behind every new symbol, a senior-PO clarify round with an intent restatement, an end-to-end coverage map and a memory-is-a-hypothesis rule, six question banks, five review checks, the ship gate, a frontend design law with an AI-tell catalog, a design scout and a pre-flight, and twelve ready-made design specs. 126 sections, loaded only when the phase calls for them. Every phase runs as an agent on a named model and that is the default: sonnet where the phase writes code or runs commands, opus where it plans, judges or decides, each carrying its shape's prompt pasted whole, while the session keeps the anchor, the ledger, every question, the gate and every claim; the plan phase's opus agent writes the work-doc itself, at the one path it is allowed to touch, and this session reads it back against the repository before the gate; /engineering-rules:agents off runs every phase in the conversation instead. One goal per task, with every pre-existing defect found on the way filed as a follow-up instead of fixed; a quick-never-lazy-never-approximate rule that binds the session and every agent; shipping in small verified releases with a six-row proof before any deploy and a live verify after; and a ten-minute check-in that keeps the work-doc, the brief and the drift check current. /engineering-rules:quick, :full, :shape, :explore-feature, :audit, :triage, :skill, :design and :log pick a route by the user's word, the bare invocation walks the user through the options before anything starts, and full mode is the default. In full mode the work-doc is the map the work follows, and nothing at the tool boundary enforces it: the gate hook is gone, and so is full mode's stop for a plan sign-off, so the plan is written, read back, said in chat and built. Three hooks enforce the law at the tool boundary: an edit guard, a file cap and a re-anchor after compaction. The explore-feature page can carry one real run of the traced code: the arguments, results, errors, timings and branch outcomes at every function inside the excerpts, masked before they reach disk, captured from the project's own test or a live request, on Bun and Node, and never written into the explored repository. generate-pseudocode turns 'explain how this code flow works' into one published page of complete pseudocode, every helper expanded and every line cited, with a note on why each line is the way it is and a closing analysis; it triggers on its own description or by /engineering-rules:generate-pseudocode.
